task.title: Renderer-wide migration to the approved Claude Design system
task.objective: Replace the entire renderer user interface with the owner-approved Claude Design system: one token foundation in global.css with light and dark modes, migrated application shell, login, shared components, every page, the workflow editing surfaces, the administration and reporting surfaces, and the new Live Run Monitor replacing the old Live Workflow Execution presentation. Preserve accent customization, reduced motion, focus-visible accessibility, Electron drag behavior, React Flow canvas measurement, existing test hooks and every IPC and runtime contract. No internet dependencies, no CDN assets, no remote fonts and no second styling framework.

acceptance.description: A single design-token foundation in global.css expresses the approved Claude Design system in light and dark mode, with no remote fonts or CDN assets, while user Accent Color, prefers-reduced-motion and accessible :focus-visible behavior are preserved.
The shell, login, shared components and every application page use the new system with no legacy styling islands, and the existing test hooks and DOM contracts the verifiers depend on are preserved.
Workflow Builder and Flow Designer chrome is migrated while React Flow measurement, canvas performance memoization, node and edge behavior, persistence and execution contracts are unchanged.

The Live Workflow Execution presentation is replaced by the approved Live Run Monitor with every enabled control wired to real runtime behavior and no fabricated progress, preserving the existing execution IPC contract.
